title: Overcome Cross-Race Effect
description: When meeting new people: - Focus on details: Pay attention to unique features, like hairstyle, clothing, or mannerisms. - Make connections: Associate the person with an activity or place to reinforce recognition. - Practice mindfulness: Avoid rushing interactions—give yourself time to observe. Example: If you meet someone at a conference, link their face to a topic they discussed.
